cashRateContract.series: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rate - 3-Month
cashRateContract.availabilityRule: Use only an observation published and ingested before the policy decision cutoff; missing remains unavailable.

weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step1: Confirm the candidate date is an actual completed regular US trading session.
weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step2: Refresh and seal the 216-security current QC source universe; do not reuse the Tuesday rank as a Friday signal.
weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step3: Refresh unadjusted closes, splits, dividends, identity and tradability for the newly selected top/bottom securities.
weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step4: Refresh SPY and all required sector ETF prices and actions.
weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step5: Store the latest cutoff-safe 3-month Treasury rate or stop with CASH_RATE_UNAVAILABLE.
weeklyCloseExecutionPlan.step6: Seal signals, input hashes and all six counterfactual arms; first fills occur no earlier than the next trading close.
